The '''ClanRing''' was a piece of jewelry rumored to have been created by [[the First Riileb]], a mythical founding figure amongst the [[Riileb (species)|Riileb]] species native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Riileb/Legends|Riileb]]. The ClanRing would be held by the Riileb whom controlled Riileb society, the eldest [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[MotherClan|motherclan]], a group of Riileb supposedly descended from the First Riileb. The female would inherit it at the age of 30 in local years, which was the equivalent of 30 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]]. Political infighting and deceit was common amongst the motherclan and heirs would often be disposed of by other members who stood to inherit after them.<ref name="AE" /> [[Tere Metallo]] was one such heir and was sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] by a jealous [[Tere Metallo's sister|sister]] at the age of 25.<ref name="RwD">{{JournalCite|6|Rendezvous with Destiny}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ClanRing was first mentioned in the short story "[[Rendezvous with Destiny]]" written by [[Charlene Newcomb]] which was published in [[1995]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of roleplaying supplements for the [[West End Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. It was then mentioned again in the article "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]" by [[Brian Smithson]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth]] issue of the series published in [[1997]]. The article was then published again in a reduced form in ''[[Alien Encounters]]'' in [[1998]], a collection of all the "Alien Encounters" articles compiled by [[Paul Sudlow]].
